notes: D1 oracle is docs/east-midlands-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/east-midlands/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.
Two agencies, two direction models, one shared hub name (Nottingham Station) with doNotGroup between the layers. See direction-model-memo.md.
NET modes v1: TRAIN-like light rail only (tram). Two lines, Line 1 and Line 2. No Line 3 passenger service.

National Rail modes v1: heavy rail, destination-board model (not line+terminus). BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN — see coverageGaps. Build the catalog/adapter normally per Nico's report; do not wire the token until it exists.

Hub lock: Nottingham Station (NOT CRS). NET tram viaduct above National Rail main platforms, footbridge connects. doNotGroup NET tram vs National Rail at this station — separate infrastructure, separate operators, separate boarding areas.

Tamworth is a genuine shared National Rail platform with West Midlands — this is a D2 de-dup boundary for a FUTURE West Midlands pack, not an East Midlands D1 concern. Do not build any cross-region merge logic here.

Leicester, Kettering, Wellingborough, Chesterfield, Alfreton are through-running-only National Rail stations (same operator continuing across the regional boundary, not a shared-platform merge point). Routing/filter concern for whichever regions ship National Rail, not a station-graph merge concern.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as West Midlands / Greater Manchester / Liverpool City Region.

NET Line 1/Line 2 station arrays below are TERMINI-ONLY — the oracle report does not give an intermediate stop order. This is a real gap, not an omission; see hazard-pack.md H4/H5 and direction-model-memo.md. Jim should confirm the full ordered stop list against the DFT GTFS feed before building the adapter's station graph.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown is left empty for NET — the report does not state the GTFS route_id for either line. Do not guess it; read it off the DFT feed at D2.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Two locks sharing one printed name, one building, doNotGroup between them. See hazard-pack.md H1/H6.

coverageGaps: NET real-time: no public GTFS-RT API confirmed. v1 is schedule-only for NET.

National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. Confidence: unclear (per oracle report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here; do not assume permission to relay Darwin data to end users until Tim confirms against the signed RDM Data Sharing Agreement.
NET Line 1 and Line 2 intermediate stop order is not in the oracle report — termini only. Do not treat the 'stations' arrays below as complete; pull the DFT GTFS feed at D2 for the real ordered list.

National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe (Darwin is a real-time per-station board product) — no 'lines' array is provided for National Rail in this pack, only the hub and through-running station list. See direction-model-memo.md for the destination+operator model recommended instead of line+terminus.
Tamworth shared-platform de-dup with West Midlands is explicitly out of scope for this pack — D2 concern for a future West Midlands pack.
No buses, no other operators, no NET real-time in v1 scope, per the oracle report.
